purpose: Fuse source-bound fragments from multiple models or agents without allowing order, scoring, consensus, or sampling to manufacture evidence.

hard_gates.rule: Every fragment carries stable identity plus source/ref or explicit TOKEN_VAZIO provenance.
Source literal is immutable; normalization is derived.
Every absent, empty, null, or unknown state uses the typed-void lattice; no coercion to zero, false, empty string, null, or empty set.
Conflicting concrete values produce CONTRADICTION unless an explicit authority rule resolves them; ranking weights alone cannot resolve truth.
Canonical fusion must be invariant to bounded permutations of the same fragment multiset; otherwise emit ORDER_SENSITIVE and cap promotion.
Seeded or sampled order may schedule search only; it has zero automatic evidence effect.
Deduplicate by source-bound identity or canonical payload, never by semantic similarity alone.
All generated compositions remain CANDIDATE with claim_allowed=false until independent evidence gates pass.

weight_policy.rule: Weights may rank which candidate to inspect first, but must not resolve contradiction or replace evidence.

permutation_policy.bounded_exhaustive_rule: For n<=7, test canonical fusion across every permutation when computationally feasible.
permutation_policy.large_n_rule: For n>7, canonical order is authoritative; deterministic sampled permutations are metamorphic probes only and exhaustive invariance remains TOKEN_VAZIO unless proven.
permutation_policy.sampling_rule: Sampling order is never a proof source and never changes canonical identity.

combination_policy.rule: Subsets and combinations may generate hypotheses or candidates; omitted fragments remain explicit in candidate coverage.
